The file browser is used to visually browse the directory structure to
select a file for reading or writing.  You may use the arrow keys or Page
Up/Down to browse through the files, and S or Enter to choose the
selected file or enter the selected directory.  To move up one level,
select the directory called ".." at the top of the file list.
The following function keys are available in the file browser:
◂                Go to the previous file in the list
^L Refresh   ^F Where Is  M-B Previous ^P Prev Line ^Y Prev Page M-\ First Line
^X Close     ^B Where Was M-F Next     ^N Next Line ^V Next Page M-/ Last Line
^G Help      ^/ Go To Dir ^F Where Is  M-B Previous ◂ Back       ^P Prev Line
^X Close     ^L Refresh   ^B Where Was M-F Next     ▸ Forward    ^N Next Line
